title: Great for small jobs. Thin metal
text: Great for small jobs. Thin metal. I love the lid.  It wastes less oil because most of it drains back into the pan.  The pan is thinner than expected.  It fries well.  Love the thermometer addition.

product_metadata.title: Deep Fryer Pot (°F) - Stylish Tempura Fryer - Small Japanese Style 114oz Stainless Steel Deep Frying Pot With Lid & Oil Drip Drainer Rack and Detachable Fahrenheit Temperature Control - Size: 9.8 Inches
features: Cooking Made Easy - Deep frying your food just got a whole lot easier. simply pour the oil into the stainless steel deep frying pan, put it on your stove, and start frying your tasty meal, it's that simple. The mini deep fryer is easily assembled

High-Grade Stainless Steel - With a focus on premium quality our deep fryer pots have been finished to the highest standards, made to last with a high grade 304 stainless steel. This tempura fryer withstands high heat and holds the heat inside the frying pot evenly. The fryer pot is compatible with induction, ceramic, gas, and electric stoves.

Easy To Clean & No More Messy Frying - The tempura fryer is 100% dishwasher safe so you can create lasting memories with your friends and family knowing that at the end of the night, all you need to do is throw them in the dishwasher. The lid on the pot keeps the oil splatter down to a minimum and the custom-designed v-shaped spout makes it easy to pour the oil without spilling

Easy To Control The Temperature - The Japanese deep frying pot has a detachable Fahrenheit thermometer, making it easy to control the temperature to ensure a perfectly cooked meal. Do not wash the thermometer, wait for it to cool, and wipe with a paper towel

Our Promise To You - If you are not satisfied with our product within the next 30 days we will refund or replace your product. This signifies our determination to ensure quality and customer happiness. Plus a 1 year warranty is included with all our products. add this new partner to your kitchen so you can easily cook a delicious deep fried meal in the comfort of your home.
